items.exampleEn: Scholars have long studied the great libraries of antiquity.
items.exampleZh: 學者們長久以來都在研究古代的大型圖書館。

items.exampleEn: A short lapse in attention can cause a serious accident on the road.
items.exampleZh: 在路上稍一分心，就可能造成嚴重的車禍。
items.glossZh: 一時疏忽；（時間）流逝；失效

items.exampleEn: There was no respite for him: the phone rang again the moment he sat down.
items.exampleZh: 他完全沒有喘息的機會：他一坐下，電話又響了。

items.exampleEn: The music at the party continued without cessation until dawn.
items.exampleZh: 派對上的音樂毫不停歇，一直持續到天亮。

items.exampleEn: Grandpa's antiquated camera still takes good photos.
items.exampleZh: 爺爺那台老舊的相機還是能拍出好照片。

items.exampleEn: The ceaseless barking of the dog next door drove us crazy.
items.exampleZh: 隔壁那隻狗不停地吠叫，快把我們逼瘋了。

items.exampleEn: He talked ceaselessly about his new car during dinner.
items.exampleZh: 吃晚餐時，他滔滔不絕地一直在講他的新車。

items.sentenceEn: The rain fell ceaselessly for three days.

items.audioEn: Our office still uses an antiquated computer system, so reports take hours to print.
items.audioZh: 我們辦公室還在用老舊的電腦系統，所以報告要花好幾個小時才印得出來。
items.questionZh: 報告為什麼要花好幾個小時才印得出來？
options: The printer is out of paper

items.sentenceEn: The workers finally got a brief respite from the heat.
items.sentenceZh: 工人們終於能暫時避開高溫、喘一口氣。

items.sentenceEn: My gym membership lapsed because I forgot to pay.
items.sentenceZh: 我忘了繳費，所以健身房會員資格失效了。

items.stemEn: After weeks of ____ work, the team finally finished the bridge.
items.stemZh: 經過幾個星期不停歇的工作，團隊終於完成了這座橋。

items.stemEn: The company announced the ____ of production at its old factory.
items.stemZh: 公司宣佈舊工廠停止生產。

items.passageEn: The town museum is small, but it holds coins and pots from antiquity. For years, it used antiquated display cases that let in dust, and visitors complained that the labels were hard to read. Last spring, the museum closed for two months. The cessation of normal activities gave the staff a welcome respite from the ceaseless flow of school groups, and they used the time to install new cases and clearer labels. The work was principally paid for by local families. There was one small lapse: nobody told the schools beforehand, so a few teachers arrived with their classes to find the doors closed.
items.passageZh: 鎮上的博物館很小，但收藏了古代的錢幣和陶器。多年來，館內使用的老舊展示櫃會進灰塵，參觀者也抱怨標示很難看懂。去年春天，博物館休館兩個月。平常的活動暫停，讓工作人員從絡繹不絕的學校團體中得到難得的喘息，他們利用這段時間裝設了新的展示櫃和更清楚的標示。這項工程主要由當地家庭出資。過程中有一個小疏失：沒有人事先通知學校，所以有幾位老師帶著學生來到館前，卻吃了閉門羹。

questions.questionZh: 博物館休館期間，工作人員做了什麼？
options: 到各地尋找更多古代文物
把古錢幣借給其他城市
為學校團體設計新的導覽
裝設新展示櫃和清楚的標示

questions.questionZh: 文中提到的疏失是什麼？
options: 新標示上的年份寫錯了

items.promptZh: 這尊雕像可以追溯到古代。
referenceEn: This statue dates back to antiquity.
This old statue dates from antiquity.
rubricZh: 「可以追溯到」可寫，例如 date back to、date from、dates back to antiquity 等
antiquity 指「古代」，前面通常不加冠詞

items.promptZh: 很多年輕人覺得寫信是一種過時的溝通方式。
referenceEn: Many young people think letter writing is an antiquated way to communicate.
Many young people see writing letters as an antiquated way of communicating.
rubricZh: antiquated 表示「過時的」（例如 an antiquated way 等）
「寫信」可寫，例如 writing letters、letter writing 等
